name: Acres
shortDescription: Parcel maps for land. A free account exists. Plus is $9.99 per month.
longDescription: Acres is a land-intelligence map. You can start free for basic property insights. Plus is $9.99 per month (or $7.49 per month on the other published figure), and Acres+ includes a 7-day free trial.
pricingNotes: Plus is $9.99 per month, also shown at $7.49 per month. Free account for basic insights. Acres+ trial is 7 days.
bestFor: Looking up parcels and basic property insights before a paid owner search
notIdealFor: Someone who needs comps on the free account
strength: A free account can view basic parcel insights, and Plus is listed at $9.99 per month.
weakness: Owner mailing address and sold-land comps sit on the paid plans, not the free account.

useCaseFit.find-land: Shows parcel maps and basic insights on a free account, with owner lookup on Plus.
useCaseFit.real-estate: Shows parcel maps and basic land insights before an owner lookup.
